items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'I want Aunt Jemima to sing it.'

ctx.x:
They had a ticket ...(?)... And it looked like they would just punch my stubs all over, and I know I ain't ate that much, but they would keep punching it like I done ate a whole lot of food, you know. And every intermission, Koko would say, "Come on, Lu, let's take a rest." And we would eat, you know.

So one night, a guy came in there, and he said, "I want music, maestro, please. But don't let him sing it (speaking of Danny)." He said, "I want Aunt Jemima to sing it." [LAUGHS HEARTILY] So Metcalf got up, and…
